definitions.explanation: One of the first major professional women writers of modern Japan, known for stories such as {たけくらべ} depicting life on the margins of Tokyo society. She died of tuberculosis at 24 but is a fixture of the school literary canon and was the face of the ¥5,000 note from 2004 to 2024.

examples.english: Higuchi Ichiyo died at 24, but in her short life she left behind many celebrated works.

notes:
Usually called {一葉|いちよう} in casual reference, the pen name alone.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一葉|いちよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: a work by Ichiyo
- {たけくらべ}: her best-known novella, set among children in Tokyo's old red-light district

CULTURAL NOTE:
She was one of the first women to earn a living as a professional novelist in modern Japan, publishing in the years just before her death from tuberculosis at 24. Her portrait appeared on the ¥5,000 note from 2004 to 2024, when she was replaced by {津田梅子|つだうめこ} in the redesign.
